careful_start.speaker: mira_vale
careful_start.text: In 2026 you chose to check twice. That habit is still on this team.

fast_start.speaker: mira_vale
fast_start.text: You moved fast in 2026. This year we also move smart.

assisted_once.speaker: samira_shah
assisted_once.text: We helped each other more than once. That is how trust grows.

contamination_noted.speaker: amara_okonkwo
contamination_noted.text: That early contaminated sample taught us to sterilize twice.

launch_delay.speaker: leo_marchetti
launch_delay.text: The launch delay kept everyone calm and rested.

signal_leaked.speaker: yuki_tanaka
signal_leaked.text: Reporters still ask about the 2026 signal. I say it is unconfirmed.

jumped_to_aliens.speaker: mira_vale
jumped_to_aliens.text: We once guessed too far. Now we prefer evidence.

signal_logged_full.speaker: yuki_tanaka
signal_logged_full.text: Every pulse of the 2026 signal is still in the log.

signal_logged_partial.speaker: yuki_tanaka
signal_logged_partial.text: We only caught part of the 2026 signal. We still listen.

ai_rejected.speaker: dev_malhotra
ai_rejected.text: You caught the helper's mistake in 2027. We still check.

premature_hail.speaker: mira_vale
premature_hail.text: We once replied too soon. We will not do that again.

alert_expired.speaker: mira_vale
alert_expired.text: An old alert once waited too long. We learned to triage fast.

mission_retried.speaker: samira_shah
mission_retried.text: You took a second go at a mission. Good teams do that.
